topic: Recognition of property, plant and equipment
question: Explain the recognition criteria for an item of property, plant and equipment under AS 10. How are spare parts and subsequent costs treated?
sources: AS 10 Property, Plant and Equipment - definitions, recognition and subsequent costs

points.label: Meaning of PPE
points.description: Tangible items held for use in producing or supplying goods or services, for rental to others or for administrative purposes, and expected to be used for more than one period.
points.basis: AS 10, definition of property, plant and equipment

points.label: Probable future economic benefits
points.description: The cost of an item is recognised as an asset only if it is probable that future economic benefits linked to it will flow to the enterprise.

points.label: Reliable measurement
points.description: The second condition is that the cost of the item can be measured reliably.

points.label: Spare parts and servicing equipment
points.description: Spare parts, stand-by equipment and servicing equipment are recognised as PPE when they meet the definition; otherwise they are treated as inventory.
points.basis: AS 10, recognition: spare parts, stand-by and servicing equipment

points.label: Subsequent costs
points.description: Day-to-day servicing is charged to profit or loss; replacement of parts and major inspections are added to the carrying amount if the recognition criteria are met, and the carrying amount of the replaced part is derecognised.
